name: leap_takeoff_heavy
for: boss leap/dive take-off (Screamer drowning leap, Mother rising under, Horror out of the fog, Drake dive, Krix/Lurz echo leaps)
notes: The light take-off at boss weight: a bigger, slower dust clot thrown back (-x), more and larger pebbles that bounce and settle. Built at about 45 px/m (Keening Cage density). Screamer is ~28 px/m and Mother ~34 px/m, so scale by px_per_m. 12 frames @ 12 fps.
